name: Zeloc
description: Zeloc was a planet in the fifth orbit around the star Velm. It was the second of two gas giants in the Velm system, located in the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. Zeloc was orbited by eleven moons, and it was also encircled by a ring system.
